newsitem.title: USA: BEFORE THE BELL - Komag, Canandaigua fall.
newsitem.headline: BEFORE THE BELL - Komag, Canandaigua fall.

text.p: Shares in Canandaigua Wine Co Inc and Komag Inc fell sharply preceding Friday's U.S. market open after profit warnings from both companies, traders said.
Ahead of the opening bell, Canandaigua was off 1-1/2 to 20-1/2 while Komag was down 3-3/4 to 17, they said.
Canandaigua said last night it had cut its earnings estimate for the fiscal year ending February 28, 1997, to $1.10-$1.40 per share from $2.30-$2.50.
Canandaigua earned $1.92 per share in the previous year, exclusive of nonrecurring and one-time items.
The company said it revised its outlook due to a lower-than-expected performance by its wine division, offset in part by a better-than-expected performance by its beer and spirits division.
Komag said it expects third quarter earnings and sales to be below previous forecasts, primarily due to lower-than-expected shipments of its latest product line.
Komag said it expects earnings of $0.30 to $0.50 a share on sales of $125 million to $140 million.
It previously said it expected earnings to at least match the $0.61 a share of the 1995 third quarter.
CyberOptics Corp is also expected to start the trading session lower after warning of a third quarter loss.
The stock was quoted at 11-1/2 bid, 11-1/2 asked preceding the market open after ending Thursday Nasdaq trade at 12-3/8.
Kent Electronics Corp is expected to suffer a similar selloff. The stock was offered at 19-1/4 after closing at 21-3/8 on the New York Stock Exchange.
Kent said it expects lower second quarter earnings per share, citing weakness in electronics manufacturing and distribution.
